question.problem:
Suppose $T:V\to W$ is a linear map and $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\}$ and $C=\{{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\}$ are the bases of the vector spaces $V$ and $W$, respectively. Find the matrix $[T]_{B|C}$ of the map $T$ relative to these bases, if 

$\,$ $T({b}_{1})=2{c}_{2}-3{c}_{1},\,$ $T({b}_{2})=4{c}_{1}-2{c}_{2}\,$ and $\,T({b}_{3})=7{c}_{2}-5{c}_{1}.$
question.worked_solution:
First, we write the images of vectors in $B$ relative to the basis $C:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}T({b}_{1})=2{c}_{2}-3{c}_{1} & \,⟹\,[T({b}_{1})]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\ T({b}_{2})=4{c}_{1}-2{c}_{2} & \,⟹\,[T({b}_{2})]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\ T({b}_{3})=7{c}_{2}-5{c}_{1} & \,⟹\,[T({b}_{3})]_{C}=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 7\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, $[T]_{B|C}$ is the matrix  whose columns are the coordinates of the vectors $T({b}_{1}),$ $T({b}_{2})$ and $T({b}_{3})$ relative to the basis $C:$

$$
[T]_{B|C}=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 & -5 \\ 2 & -2 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$
